Architecture: Pure UI component - only handles visual representation Subscribes to console-specific input events (not toggle - that's handled by ConsoleService) Uses events to communicate back to console system Optimized string building for better performance Input Handling Flow: InputManager detects console input (submit, tab, history) InputManager publishes console input events ConsoleGUI receives events and updates UI accordingly ConsoleGUI calls Console static methods to execute commands Interfaces IConsoleCommand Interface for console commands that can be executed from the command line Provides metadata and execution context for modular command system IConsoleContext Context interface providing access to console functionality Allows commands to interact with the console system safely without direct access to internal state Acts as a controlled facade that prevents commands from breaking console integrity IConsoleUI
